findings.claim: 2026年Q2 backlog 為 $14.06B（Q1 $12.45B、去年同期 $8.12B）；同店 backlog $13.70B；同店營收成長 44%
findings.source: Comfort Systems USA Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results (BusinessWire)
findings.excerpt: Backlog as of June 30, 2026 was $14.06 billion as compared to $12.45 billion as of March 31, 2026 and $8.12 billion as of June 30, 2025.

findings.claim: Technology（資料中心）佔上半年營收 58%，去年同期 40%；管理層稱專案管線處歷史高檔、未見資料中心需求放緩；全年同店營收成長指引中高 30% 區間
findings.source: Comfort Systems USA Q2 Earnings Call Highlights (Nasdaq)
findings.excerpt: Technology generated 58% of first-half revenues, up from 40% in the prior-year period.

findings.claim: 分部營收（2025前九個月）：機械 +19.0% 至 $4.85B，電氣 +47.9% 至 $1.60B；2026年分部數字聚合站互相矛盾，未採信
findings.source: Nasdaq: Can Mechanical & Electrical Strength Support Comfort Systems in 2026?
findings.excerpt: Revenues for the mechanical segment increased 19.0% to $4.85 billion. Revenues for the electrical segment rose 47.9% to $1.60 billion.

note: Q3 2026 尚未發布。市佔與定價趨勢、E&C TAM 共識：未找到可引來源（IBISWorld 付費牆）。第3條 as_of 為估計，原文僅知屬2026年文章。
